symbols.note: copied by hand from gatekit symbols system --dll dx11 (addresses are bg3_dx11.exe). Methods with null address were listed by the Toolkit but the tool printed no game address for them. System index variable bg3_dx11.exe+0x60D93A8; the game functions using the index are in the Toolkit line of the tool output. The does layer cites EoCServer.dll (Toolkit pseudo-code with real names) wherever bg3_dx11.exe functions were not individually mapped.
symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Per frame it runs ProcessThrownItems, then ProcessReturnToOwner, then GenerateEquipRequests, the last two sharing a frame-local data block that is cleaned up afterwards.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xF02890 read (the three calls in this order); bg3_dx11.exe+0x23450A0 (608 b) is the function that uses the system index and the unchecked ReturnToOwnerComponent type

does.text: Looks at items for which something was removed this frame (a removed-tag query; its read types include the projectile attachment, so likely items released from a projectile), builds an attack description with no target health, tests the item's boosts container for an active boost, and under that test adds a component to the item through the command buffer. ReturnToOwnerComponent is the only own component in the write list, so it is the likely one. That this is a thrown weapon returning to its owner is a guess from the type names.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xF01E00 read in part: AttackDesc and HitDesc built, HasActiveBoost on BoostsContainerComponent, an AddComponent assertion string; the boost tested and the component added are not resolved

does.text: Walks entities holding ReturnToOwnerComponent and, when it is done with one, removes a component from it through the command buffer. IsFalling, ownership history and current ownee are read-only inputs.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xF019A0 read in part: one RemoveComponentUnchecked; read-only inputs from the WorldView

does.text: By its name and by ReturnToOwnerEquipRequestComponent in the write list, it makes equip requests for a returned item. This is a guess from names; the body was only read for structure.

unknown: the condition under which ReturnToOwnerComponent is added (the boost tested, the removal that triggers it)
how a returning item reaches the owner
sure: no: the central condition is unresolved
